c.description: array of shape ``(..., N)`` specifying the first column.
constraints: c and r leading dimensions must be broadcast-compatible
if r not specified, defaults to conj(c)
if complex-valued c, r defaults to c.conj()
for N-dimensional c and/or r, the result is a batch of Toeplitz matrices

r.description: (optional) array of shape ``(..., M)`` specifying the first row. Leading dimensions must be broadcast-compatible with those of ``c``. If not specified, ``r`` defaults to ``conj(c)``.
constraints: c and r leading dimensions must be broadcast-compatible
if r not specified, defaults to conj(c)
if complex-valued c, r defaults to c.conj()
for N-dimensional c and/or r, the result is a batch of Toeplitz matrices

output.description: A Toeplitz matrix of shape ``(... N, M)``.

constraints: c and r leading dimensions must be broadcast-compatible
if r not specified, defaults to conj(c)
if complex-valued c, r defaults to c.conj()
for N-dimensional c and/or r, the result is a batch of Toeplitz matrices
